data.one_liner: Dart library for calculating Jewish calendar dates and halachic times.
data.what_it_does: Provides classes to compute Hebrew dates, Jewish holidays, and astronomical times such as sunrise, sunset, and prayer times. It mirrors the KosherJava Zmanim API in Dart.
use_when: You need Jewish calendar calculations in a Dart or Flutter app
You require prayer time or zmanim calculations without writing your own astronomy code
avoid_when: You need a full-featured UI widget set for displaying dates
You require a backend service for calendar data
strengths: Comprehensive support for Jewish holidays and date navigation
weaknesses: Limited to Jewish calendar; not a general date‑time utility
